title: 序章15 混血的风尘女子序章16 圈子往事
content_zh:
昏暗的房间内，到处弥漫一股刺鼻的气味。
黎木根据颠簸的感觉，以及乘车的时间推断，自己所在的位置，距离矿坑最多不会超过5公里。
也就是说，自己很有可能被带到了矿区的最边缘，集市街。
只要不去内陆城市，自己就还有机会逃离马尔提雅人的控制。
正这么想着，房间的门突然被打开了。
一名神色黯淡的女子，端着一盘粗麦粥和硬面包一瘸一拐地走了进来。
女人什么都没有说，只是把吃的放下就离开了。
不过敏锐的黎木在那一瞬间开启精神过载，还是觉察到了什么。
这个女人身上有不少淤青、骨折，甚至从皮相上看，极有可能染上了花柳病。
“从事风俗行业的女子吗？”
黎木推断着说道，“这么说，自己现在所处地方，很可能也是集市街的一处风月店附近。”
而且，女子开门的一瞬间，黎木还看到了外面的样子。
一条过道，大量房门紧密相连，和自己所处的狭窄且不透光房间应该都差不多。
有可能，这里是专门用于奴隶交易，或者关押人质的场所。
“除了项圈，没有给自己带脚铐手铐之类的...”
黎木皱了皱眉头。
他倒情愿对方多做一些，这样反而显得好对付。
就怕这种看起来不做什么措施，让你不知道对方有什么手段的。
摸了摸脖子处的项圈。
现在的黎木除了能分析出，其中拥有某种与灵魂有关的东西，不能随便摘下来，剩下的就只知道，一旦周围有人朝你念咒语可直接致晕。

简单吃完食物。
一直坐着乱想也没用，黎木索性站起身子摸索起来。
既然身体没被束缚，自然还是要尽力找一找破局的办法。
转悠了几圈，除了刚送来的吃的，什么都没有。
不过后面的墙体稍作敲击后，黎木判断后面是一块巨大的实体。
正常的墙不会修这么厚。
换言之，这里很可能是在地下。
联系起来，这里很可能在妓院地下。
保留猜测，黎木继续探查起来。
“卡擦咔擦~”
没想到的是，在推木门的时候，竟然轻松推开了。
透过门缝，黎木小心翼翼的往外看。
狭长的过道两侧，都是类似自己这种房间，粗略估计有几百个，过道的两端则是向上的楼梯。
“......”
虽然整个过道看起来空荡荡的，但黎木估计，楼梯上面会有守卫之类的。
content_en:
There was a pungent smell everywhere in the dim room.
Based on the feeling of bumps and the time of the ride, Li Mu concluded that his location was no more than 5 kilometers away from the mine.
In other words, it is very likely that he was taken to the edge of the mining area, the market street.
As long as he doesn't go to the inland cities, he still has a chance to escape from the control of the Martians.
Just as he was thinking this, the door to the room suddenly opened.
A gloomy-looking woman limped in, carrying a plate of couscous and hard bread.
The woman didn't say anything, she just put down the food and left.
However, the keen Li Mu turned on his mental overload at that moment and still noticed something.
This woman had a lot of bruises and fractures on her body, and judging from her appearance, she was very likely to have contracted the disease.
"A woman engaged in the custom industry?"
Li Mu deduced and said, "So, the place where I am now is probably near a Fengyue store on Market Street."
Moreover, the moment the woman opened the door, Li Mu also saw what was outside.
A corridor with a large number of doors closely connected, it should be similar to the narrow and light-tight room he is in.
It's possible that this was a place specifically used for slave trading or for holding hostages.
"Except for the collar, I didn't wear any leg or handcuffs on myself..."
Li Mu frowned.
He would rather the other party do more, which would make it easier to deal with.
I'm afraid that if you don't seem to take any measures, you won't know what the other party's methods are.
He touched the collar around his neck.
Now Li Mu can not only analyze that there is something related to the soul in it, but it cannot be picked off casually. The only thing left is that once someone around you chants a spell at you, you can be stunned directly.
Eat your food simply.
There was no use sitting there thinking about it all the time, so Li Mu simply stood up and started groping.
Since the body is not restrained, naturally we still have to try our best to find a way to break the situation.
After wandering around for a few times, there was nothing except the food that had just been delivered.
However, after tapping the wall behind, Li Mu judged that there was a huge entity behind it.
Normal walls would not be built this thick.
In other words, it's probably underground.
To put it into context, this place is probably underground in a brothel.
Reserving speculation, Li Mu continued to investigate.
"Kacha kacha~"
Unexpectedly, when I pushed the wooden door, it opened easily.
Through the crack in the door, Li Mu looked out cautiously.
On both sides of the long and narrow corridor, there are rooms similar to mine. There are roughly hundreds of them. At both ends of the corridor are stairs leading upward.
"..."
Although the entire corridor looked empty, Li Mu estimated that there would be guards on the stairs.
